description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityOperator' that serves as a base for various types of operators (comparison, Boolean, join) used in building entity query conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes registration and lookup mechanisms for operators, some predefined static operator instances (e.g., EQUALS, NOT_EQUAL, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, AND, OR), and methods for comparing entities, constructing SQL strings, and managing operator properties.

classes.name: EntityOperator
classes.description: An abstract base class for entity query operators, including comparison operators (equals, not equal, less than, etc.), logical operators (AND, OR), and collection operators (IN, BETWEEN). It manages registration and lookup of operators, and defines methods for comparison, SQL generation, and validation.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if a given entity matches the condition defined by the operator using the entity's delegator, the entity, and the provided lhs and rhs operands.

methods.name: appendRHSList
methods.description: Appends a list of values (for IN clause) to the SQL where string, properly formatting the list.

methods.name: appendRHSBetweenList
methods.description: Appends a list of values (for BETWEEN clause) to the SQL where string, separated by AND.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the left and right operands constitute an 'empty' condition.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the entity matches the condition when supplied with a map of field values.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Abstract method to validate the SQL generated for the specific condition against the entity model.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Adds the SQL representation of the operand to the SQL statement, considering compatibility and the datasource.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns a frozen representation of the condition (possibly an immutable form).
